# HandleDestroy

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Closes a handle and, for a space, tears the space down.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x08` SVC_MANAGEHANDLE | `MNGHNDL_DESTROY (4)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err HandleDestroy(Handle h);
```

**Registers:** `(h) -> r0 status`

Destroying a space kills all its tasks and releases everything it holds. For any other object this is the same as HandleClose().

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to destroy. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `h` names the caller's own space or one of its ancestors. |
